meta.name: geniml
meta.description: Use Geniml for audited local genomic-interval workflows: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证并规划本地基因组间隔工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果处理基因组数据并需要验证BED文件
copy.tagline_en: Validate and plan local genomic-interval workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with genomic data and need to validate BED files

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会识别与基因组区间(BED 文件)相关的机器学习任务,并给出 geniml 的使用步骤和命令,例如训练 Region2Vec 区域嵌入、用 scEmbed 分析单细胞染色质可及性、构建 consensus peaks 参考峰集等。
howto.when: 当你提供 BED 文件或单细胞 ATAC-seq 数据,并要求做区域嵌入、构建共识峰集、或进行任何基于基因组区间的机器学习分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Region2Vec 训练 BED 文件的区域嵌入,需要什么步骤?
say.note: Claude 会给出分词、训练和评估的流程。

say.text: 如何用 scEmbed 分析我的单细胞 ATAC-seq 数据?
say.note: Claude 会说明从 AnnData 到细胞嵌入的步骤。

say.text: 给我一个构建 consensus universe 的命令行示例。
say.note: Claude 会提供覆盖度和构建命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude recognizes genomic-interval (BED) machine-learning tasks and provides geniml commands and steps, such as training Region2Vec embeddings, analyzing single-cell ATAC-seq with scEmbed, and building consensus peak sets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide BED files or single-cell ATAC-seq data and request region embeddings, consensus peak building, or any ML analysis of genomic intervals.

say_en.text: Help me train Region2Vec embeddings on BED files—what steps are needed?
say_en.note: Claude will outline tokenization, training, and evaluation.

say_en.text: How do I use scEmbed on my single-cell ATAC-seq data?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the AnnData to cell-embedding workflow.

say_en.text: Give me a command-line example for building a consensus universe.
say_en.note: Claude will show coverage and build commands.
